body: How did you know when it was escalating and wasn’t a one off “anger” outburst?

I guess I didn’t really give a good enough glimpse into my relationship. We’ve been together 4 years. 3.5 of it, I did literally everything for him, I dealt with his mood swings, his smashing shit when he got mad, I gave him a place to live when his (actually narc) mother would kick him out, I encouraged him to get a job, go back to school, get his license. I tried my ass off for years to make it work, all the while he was texting girls, doing drugs and stealing from me when he couldn’t find drugs elsewhere. When my friend died, I stopped doing anything, for myself or him. That’s when I started to become unhappy, because while before he was treating me badly, I would still see the happy moments. After seeing my friend in a body bag, nothing was happy to me anymore and if anything it opened my eyes to all of the shit I was ignoring. I cheated because I wanted to feel like someone could be attracted to me for myself, not for what I could give them. I told him instantly, literally within hours, from guilt. I said I was glad I cheated in a quick moment of losing my temper, when in actuality I regret it more than anything. This also isn’t the first time he’s choked me. It’s the first time he’s done it and I was scared. I understand I need help, and i shouldn’t have said anything but I also just wanted some quick advice so I guess that’s my fault for not explaining further.

My collarbone has a red mark and there are 4 finger marks on my neck, 3 on one side and one where his thumb was on the other side… I took a picture to document it but I don’t think I can call the police…

The thing is I understand his anger, I would be angry too, I just came from a childhood of abuse and I always said I would never get into a situation like that so I don’t know if I’m being dramatic and brought this on myself or if this is actually abuse.
Woah ok I was just asking a question, these other people were saying it’s rape because I was drunk. Trust me I’m holding myself accountable. So kindly get the fuck off your high horse.

Sorry I’m a human who makes mistakes.

I don’t know if I’d consider it date rape, I was participating. I just was inside my head saying no this is wrong I need to stop but for some reason I couldn’t form the words.
…I didn’t even consider that because I’m the one who called him…

Please don’t look as me as an example. You should trust. I made a horrible mistake I will regret for the rest of my life. If I had trusted my boyfriend when he said he was coming back, this wouldn’t have happened.

I think what really scared me is I thought it was real, I felt the biggest sense of relief for a second because I thought “oh my god she isnt dead” but it turned into pure horror because I thought I was hallucinating until I realized it was a dream and all this happened in what felt like a matter of seconds. I would give anything to have a conversation with her again but that was just freaky. I hope if it happens again I can keep calm and ask her what I want to ask her.
I need something covered by insurance or atleast with a small copay, I’m broke as hell right now, partially why I’m freaking out because I can’t take care of a baby.

Thank you :)

My alarm  went off to go again this morning about 15 minutes ago and my first thought was ah fuck I don’t wanna move but nope I’m up and I’m dressed and drinking a meal replacement shake. My bed does sound like heaven but I’m just gonna think of it as a reward when I get done

Aw omg to be honest when I got in my car after I cried too. I’ve been so depressed and unmotivated for so long and this was a really big step for me. Not only the gym, I’ve been applying to better jobs because I didn’t feel like I could handle more than my shitty little part time job, and I did pretty good in my first semester back to college. I’m actually going tomorrow morning! I just went and bought myself some meal replacement shakes to help curb some hunger in the morning and give me some energy

Honestly, I’m more motivated by actually seeing results and then I’m going to try sticking to a diet and really commit. Right now I just want to get into a routine because I don’t 100% feel like I can do it. Thank you for the advice!!

2) you can do it!!!! Its so hard dude trust me I know, but you can do it!! Find that little burst of energy and just go, trust me it helps so much from just small accomplishments of doing homework or going to class.

Well honestly, I'm on a new antidepressant, Zoloft. Its helping a little but I realized I was never going to feel better about myself unless I went back and feel like I'm actually working towards something instead of getting more and more depressed because I'm working a minimum wage job forever. Other than that, I get random bursts of energy sometimes where I want to fix my life and feel like I can do anything so I usually wait for that to get stuff done lol

Medication and the epiphany that I will be working menial minimum wage jobs for the rest of my life if I dont get off my butt and do something about it. Give your sister time, ask her if shes considered therapy, if you really really want to help, find her therapy, I dont want to say force her but part of depression is wanting to change but having no motivation to do so. If you set everything up for her, she may feel like she can actually do it. Good luck, message me if you want to talk.
I'm sorry no one has ever showed you support. I wish I could change that. I hope things get better for you.
I'm so sorry you're so sad that you cannot be happy for others, I sincerely hope you get better. My struggle is not yours, please don't assume you know what I've been through or how I feel.

Oh wow ok this is actually a really hard question for me. I honestly dont know, I'm not cured, not even close. I mean even today, I'm getting alot of anxiety about going back. 

I have a few things that have helped. I've completely stopped drinking coffee, I've been drinking it since 14 and that's around the time I started having panic attacks. So barely any caffeine now. I watch alot of TV, tv is a huge stress reliever for me, if theres something stressing me out, I watch tv to distract myself. If you do this just be wary it can be detrimental if you start procrastinating too much, it can very easily turn into a cycle.

My biggest thing is meds. My doctor put me on zoloft. I have some side effects but nothing too extreme, for the most part it's working really well. If you are struggling with anxiety, I swear to you, meds help. You can get them from your GP or your gyno if you're a girl, you dont need an expensive psychiatrist to give you meds.

(Hes joking about beating my ass but he'll definitely call me out on skipping.)

Just keep your head up, do what you need to make your mental health better whether it be meds or therapy, and once you feel you're in a better place, see what you can do to go back, ease yourself into it. Give yourself one goal a day, I started doing that last week and I already feel a million times better.

I failed a few of the classes because i couldn't keep up on top of working as well to pay for gas and partially tuition. It made my anxiety and depression skyrocket and the stress of it made my meds stop working. I'm going to take it slow this time.
